title: AutoApply socket protocol
description: NDJSON over <home>/autoapplyd.sock. GENERATED by `uv run python -m autoapply.models` from engine/autoapply/models.py - do not edit by hand. See contract/protocol.md.

AcceptReplySuggestionPayload.description: Apply an employer reply's suggested board status (``set_status``, actor user).
AcceptReplySuggestionPayload.title: AcceptReplySuggestionPayload

AckPayload.description: Success reply to a command (envelope carries ``reply_to``).
AckPayload.title: AckPayload

company_name.description: Used (find or create) when company_id is not given.
company_name.title: Company Name

linkedin_url.description: Stored as a reference only; never opened by AutoApply.
linkedin_url.title: Linkedin Url

share_ok.description: Allowed into the shared library later (off for manual contacts).
share_ok.title: Share Ok

AddJobUrlPayload.description: Add a job from any apply link (manual source) and queue it as a user choice.

url.description: Job / apply page URL (http or https; scheme optional).
url.title: Url

title.description: Override the title read from the page.
title.title: Title

company.description: Override the company read from the page.
company.title: Company

apply_now.description: Start filling right away (else it waits for the next run).
apply_now.title: Apply Now

AddJobUrlPayload.title: AddJobUrlPayload

AddReferralPayload.description: 'Could refer me': a contact (or a typed person) as a would-be referrer.
AddReferralPayload.title: AddReferralPayload

file_path.description: Absolute path to the PDF; the daemon copies it into <home>/resumes/.
file_path.title: File Path

action.description: Short verb phrase, e.g. 'answering "Years with Go"'.
action.title: Action

save_to_profile.description: Never-guess clusters: write to never_guess instead.
save_to_profile.title: Save To Profile

AppState.description: Agent state machine for an application (contract/protocol.md §State machine).
AppState.title: AppState

ApplicationReplyLabel.description:
Classification of an employer / ATS email about a submitted application
(``application_replies.label``). Every label counts as "heard back" for auto-ghosting.
ApplicationReplyLabel.title: ApplicationReplyLabel

ApplicationReplyPayload.description:
An employer / ATS email about a submitted application was read from the mailbox. A board
move is only suggested (``suggested_status``); the user confirms it with ``accept_reply_suggestion``.

title.description: The job title of the matched application.
title.title: Title

suggested_status.description: interview | assessment | rejected | offer; null for an acknowledgement, other or ambiguous match.

ambiguous.description: Several applications at this company could match; nothing is suggested.
ambiguous.title: Ambiguous

ApplicationReplyPayload.title: ApplicationReplyPayload

ApplicationStatusPayload.description: Manual board status changed (user drag-drop, auto-ghost, notification action).
ApplicationStatusPayload.title: ApplicationStatusPayload

ApplyAnywayPayload.description: User override of a hard-filter / below-threshold skip: skipped -> queued (actor user).
ApplyAnywayPayload.title: ApplyAnywayPayload

include_followups.description: Also send the one follow-up without asking again.
include_followups.title: Include Followups

send_anyway.description: Message ids the user OK'd although the address is below the confidence bar.
send_anyway.title: Send Anyway

BoardStatus.description: Manual post-apply board status (only once state == submitted).
BoardStatus.title: BoardStatus

outreach_daily_limit.description: Today's limit for new threads (the cap, lower during the first-week ramp).
outreach_daily_limit.title: Outreach Daily Limit

CompanyBrief.description: Only data AutoApply already stores (no new web lookups). Omitted from the pack when there is nothing.

other_roles.description: Other job titles seen at this company.
other_roles.title: Other Roles

CompanyBrief.title: CompanyBrief

Counts.description: Live counters for badges / hero. Derived from the DB at snapshot time.

needs_you_actions.description: How many of needs_you_clusters are agent actions (kind 'action').
needs_you_actions.title: Needs You Actions

suggestions_pending.description: Company suggestions waiting for Add / Dismiss (Settings > Sources badge).
suggestions_pending.title: Suggestions Pending

outreach_drafts.description: Cold email drafts waiting for review (Cold Email badge).
outreach_drafts.title: Outreach Drafts

outreach_replies_unread.description: Outreach threads with a reply the user has not opened (Needs You > Replies).
outreach_replies_unread.title: Outreach Replies Unread

outreach_unknown.description: Emails that may or may not have gone out (Needs You > Possibly sent).
outreach_unknown.title: Outreach Unknown

application_replies_unread.description: Employer replies with a suggested board move waiting for Accept / Dismiss (application_replies).
application_replies_unread.title: Application Replies Unread

Counts.title: Counts

suppress.description: Also put the address on the do-not-contact list.
suppress.title: Suppress

DismissReplySuggestionPayload.description: Keep the board as it is; the reply stays as evidence (and still counts as heard back).
DismissReplySuggestionPayload.title: DismissReplySuggestionPayload

instructions.description: Extra guidance for the drafter (tone, what to stress).
instructions.title: Instructions

body.description: The user's text (the footer is added separately and cannot be removed).
body.title: Body

confirm_claims.description: 'These are true': approve despite unsupported claims.
confirm_claims.title: Confirm Claims

enabled.description: true sends a test email to your own address first; sending stays off if it fails.
enabled.title: Enabled

ErrorPayload.description: Failure reply to a command (with ``reply_to``) or an unsolicited daemon error.
ErrorPayload.title: ErrorPayload

FormQuestion.description: A question harvested from an application form (ATS API or browser scan).

key.description: Stable field id/name within the form.
key.title: Key

label.description: Question text as shown to the applicant.
label.title: Label

FormQuestion.title: FormQuestion

GenerateInterviewPrepPayload.description: Build (or rebuild) the interview prep pack for one application.

force.description: Regenerate even when a pack is already stored.
force.title: Force

GenerateInterviewPrepPayload.title: GenerateInterviewPrepPayload

force.description: Recompute instead of serving the 6-hour cache.
force.title: Force

summarize.description: Also ask the fast model for a short upskill summary (spends tokens).
summarize.title: Summarize

test.description: Also log in now to check the stored password still works.
test.title: Test

ImportLinkedinConnectionsPayload.description: The user's own LinkedIn data export (``Connections.csv``), picked by the user. Never fetched from LinkedIn.

file_path.description: Path to Connections.csv (the notes preamble before the header is fine).
file_path.title: File Path

ImportLinkedinConnectionsPayload.title: ImportLinkedinConnectionsPayload

Insights.description:
``ack.result`` for ``get_insights``: advisory "learning from outcomes" report computed from the
user's own data (engine/autoapply/insights.py). It never changes any setting.

tokens_in.description: Tokens spent on the optional model summary.
tokens_in.title: Tokens In

Insights.title: Insights

InterviewDebriefPayload.description: Free-text notes written after an interview; returns a structured debrief and a thank-you draft.
InterviewDebriefPayload.title: InterviewDebriefPayload

InterviewPrepPack.description:
``ack.result`` of ``generate_interview_prep`` / ``get_interview_prep``.

Stored as JSON at ``<home>/interview_prep/<application_id>.json``. Grounded only in the job
description, the company data on file and the user's profile, resume text and story bank.

status.description: Board status when the pack was generated.

unsupported_claims.description: Claims the fact check removed (not shown anywhere in the pack).
unsupported_claims.title: Unsupported Claims

rejected_story_ids.description: Story ids the model cited that are not in the story bank.
rejected_story_ids.title: Rejected Story Ids

InterviewPrepPack.title: InterviewPrepPack

InterviewQuestion.description: A likely interview question. Behavioural questions carry the best-matching story (or a gap).

basis.description: The job-description requirement the question comes from.
basis.title: Basis

story_id.description: stories.id of the matched story (behavioural only).
story_id.title: Story Id

star_source.description: 'story' = the model's outline failed the fact check and the story's own words are shown.
star_source.title: Star Source

story_gap.description: No story fits: what kind of story to add to the story bank. Nothing is invented.
story_gap.title: Story Gap

InterviewQuestion.title: InterviewQuestion

MarkAppliedPayload.description: Board: "I applied myself" — a job the agent never submitted, dropped on Applied or a later column.
MarkAppliedPayload.title: MarkAppliedPayload

NeverGuess.description:
Facts the agent never guesses. ``None`` means "always ask me".

Each field is one row in the ``never_guess`` table (key = field name, value = JSON).

work_auth.description: Country (ISO-3166 alpha-2 or name) -> status, e.g. {'US': 'requires_sponsorship', 'IN': 'citizen'}.
work_auth.title: Work Auth

NeverGuess.title: NeverGuess

work_auth.description: Country (ISO-3166 alpha-2 or name) -> status, e.g. {'US': 'requires_sponsorship', 'IN': 'citizen'}.
work_auth.title: Work Auth

suggested_status.description: A board move the reply suggests (never applied by itself).

OutreachStatePayload.description: A cold-email thread or message changed state (the app re-reads the tables).

message_id.description: Set when a message changed; else the thread did.
message_id.title: Message Id

OutreachStatePayload.title: OutreachStatePayload

Preferences.description: Job-search preferences. Field names == ``preferences`` table columns.

work_auth_summary.description: Free text, e.g. 'India citizen; needs US sponsorship'.
work_auth_summary.title: Work Auth Summary

per_ats_mode.description: Per-ATS mode override. Missing ATS = inherit global mode.
per_ats_mode.title: Per Ats Mode

searches_per_session.description: Search result pages read per LinkedIn/Glassdoor session.
searches_per_session.title: Searches Per Session

jobs_per_session.description: Job detail pages read per LinkedIn/Glassdoor session.
jobs_per_session.title: Jobs Per Session

parallel_applications.description: Applications prepped / filled at the same time (one agent + browser each).
parallel_applications.title: Parallel Applications

create_accounts.description: Let the agent create (or reset the password of) an account on job sites that require one, using the connected mailbox for verification emails. Passwords live in the macOS Keychain.
create_accounts.title: Create Accounts

outreach_auto_scout.description: Look for people to email at a company after each submitted application (30-day cache per company).
outreach_auto_scout.title: Outreach Auto Scout

outreach_auto_draft.description: Draft an email for the best contact after a scout. Drafts are never sent without approval.
outreach_auto_draft.title: Outreach Auto Draft

outreach_daily_cap.description: New email threads per day (follow-ups count toward 2x this).
outreach_daily_cap.title: Outreach Daily Cap

outreach_followup_days.description: Business days without a reply before the one follow-up.
outreach_followup_days.title: Outreach Followup Days

outreach_send_window.description: Local [start, end] HH:MM; emails are only sent inside it.
outreach_send_window.title: Outreach Send Window

outreach_min_email_confidence.description: Emails below this confidence need 'Send anyway' per contact.
outreach_min_email_confidence.title: Outreach Min Email Confidence

people_finder_visits_per_day.description: Google result pages read per day to find people (never LinkedIn itself).
people_finder_visits_per_day.title: People Finder Visits Per Day

always_ask_patterns.description: Regexes; matching form questions always go to the inbox.
always_ask_patterns.title: Always Ask Patterns

Preferences.title: Preferences

work_auth_summary.description: Free text, e.g. 'India citizen; needs US sponsorship'.
work_auth_summary.title: Work Auth Summary

per_ats_mode.description: Per-ATS mode override. Missing ATS = inherit global mode.
per_ats_mode.title: Per Ats Mode

searches_per_session.description: Search result pages read per LinkedIn/Glassdoor session.
searches_per_session.title: Searches Per Session

jobs_per_session.description: Job detail pages read per LinkedIn/Glassdoor session.
jobs_per_session.title: Jobs Per Session

parallel_applications.description: Applications prepped / filled at the same time (one agent + browser each).
parallel_applications.title: Parallel Applications

create_accounts.description: Let the agent create (or reset the password of) an account on job sites that require one, using the connected mailbox for verification emails. Passwords live in the macOS Keychain.
create_accounts.title: Create Accounts

outreach_auto_scout.description: Look for people to email at a company after each submitted application (30-day cache per company).
outreach_auto_scout.title: Outreach Auto Scout

outreach_auto_draft.description: Draft an email for the best contact after a scout. Drafts are never sent without approval.
outreach_auto_draft.title: Outreach Auto Draft

outreach_daily_cap.description: New email threads per day (follow-ups count toward 2x this).
outreach_daily_cap.title: Outreach Daily Cap

outreach_followup_days.description: Business days without a reply before the one follow-up.
outreach_followup_days.title: Outreach Followup Days

outreach_send_window.description: Local [start, end] HH:MM; emails are only sent inside it.
outreach_send_window.title: Outreach Send Window

outreach_min_email_confidence.description: Emails below this confidence need 'Send anyway' per contact.
outreach_min_email_confidence.title: Outreach Min Email Confidence

people_finder_visits_per_day.description: Google result pages read per day to find people (never LinkedIn itself).
people_finder_visits_per_day.title: People Finder Visits Per Day

always_ask_patterns.description: Regexes; matching form questions always go to the inbox.
always_ask_patterns.title: Always Ask Patterns

ProfilePatch.description: All-optional Profile for ``update_profile``; only keys present are applied.
ProfilePatch.title: ProfilePatch

QuestionCluster.description: A Needs-You inbox cluster: semantically equivalent questions answered once.

options.description: Union of options across the cluster.
options.title: Options

suggested_answer.description: The agent's low-confidence draft, to accept or edit.
suggested_answer.title: Suggested Answer

suggested_note.description: What the draft could not cover from the user's facts (shown beside it, never inside it).
suggested_note.title: Suggested Note

kind.description: 'question': type a value for an application field. 'action': the agent is blocked and the user must do something (create an account / sign in, solve a CAPTCHA, finish a verification), then retry or skip the jobs; answer it with answer_question (save_to_memory false; the text is ignored). Unknown values must be treated as 'question'.
kind.title: Kind

QuestionCluster.title: QuestionCluster

QuestionReason.description: Why a question was parked in the Needs-You inbox.
QuestionReason.title: QuestionReason

QueueApplicationPayload.description: Board: a card dropped on Queued. discovered / scored / skipped / failed -> queued (actor user).

apply_now.description: Start filling it right away (unless paused).
apply_now.title: Apply Now

QueueApplicationPayload.title: QueueApplicationPayload

ReferralState.description: Referral copilot (the user does every LinkedIn step; transitions: ``models.REFERRAL_TRANSITIONS``).
ReferralState.title: ReferralState

RequirementBlocker.description: A requirement the scorer flagged as a concern on several skipped jobs (scores.reasons.concerns).

count.description: Skipped jobs whose concerns name it.
count.title: Count

wordings.description: Up to 2 concern texts as the scorer wrote them.
wordings.title: Wordings

RequirementBlocker.title: RequirementBlocker

sent.description: The user checked Sent Mail: true = it went out.
sent.title: Sent

submitted.description: User verified whether the submission went through.
submitted.title: Submitted

host.description: Site host as listed by list_site_accounts.
host.title: Host

ScoreBand.description: One match-score band of the calibration table (insights.py).

applications.description: Submitted applications in this band that have an outcome (in-flight ones are left out).
applications.title: Applications

responses.description: Of those, how many heard back (board status assessment / interview / offer / rejected, or an employer reply other than an automatic acknowledgement).
responses.title: Responses

interviews.description: Of those, how many reached assessment, interview or offer.
interviews.title: Interviews

response_rate.description: responses ÷ applications; null below the per-band sample floor.
response_rate.title: Response Rate

interview_rate.description: interviews ÷ applications; null below the per-band sample floor.
interview_rate.title: Interview Rate

ScoreBand.title: ScoreBand

ScoreCalibration.description: Does the match score predict replies? Advisory; nothing is changed.

min_band_sample.description: Applications a band needs before its rates are shown.
min_band_sample.title: Min Band Sample

match_threshold.description: The user's current preferences.match_threshold (for context only).
match_threshold.title: Match Threshold

resolved.description: Scored, submitted applications with an outcome.
resolved.title: Resolved

in_flight.description: Submitted recently with no reply yet: not counted.
in_flight.title: In Flight

unscored.description: Submitted applications without a match score (added by link, applied manually).
unscored.title: Unscored

finding.description: One plain-language sentence for the user.
finding.title: Finding

ScoreCalibration.title: ScoreCalibration

ScoutContactsPayload.description: Find people to email at a company (HTTP sources now; Google results when the browser is free).

application_id.description: Scout the company of this application.
application_id.title: Application Id

ScoutContactsPayload.title: ScoutContactsPayload

queued_google.description: Google results are still to be read when the browser is free.
queued_google.title: Queued Google

thread_id.description: Draft written automatically for the best contact, if any.
thread_id.title: Thread Id

SetApplicationResumePayload.description:
Swap the resume an application will use (Review ↻). An application awaiting review is
sent back to ``queued`` so the form is re-filled with the new file.
SetApplicationResumePayload.title: SetApplicationResumePayload

email.description: Mailbox the ATSs send security codes to (usually your application email).
email.title: Email

app_password.description: App password (Gmail: myaccount.google.com/apppasswords). Stored in the macOS Keychain only.
app_password.title: App Password

api_key.description: null removes the key. Stored in the macOS Keychain only.
api_key.title: Api Key

skipped.description: Jobs skipped in the window (deferrals are not skips).
skipped.title: Skipped

examples.description: Up to 3 "Title · Company" examples, newest first.
examples.title: Examples

SnapshotPayload.description: Full live state. Sent as the reply to ``hello`` (and on demand).
SnapshotPayload.title: SnapshotPayload

SourceName.description: Discovery sources whose connection status the UI shows.
SourceName.title: SourceName

StarOutline.description: Talking points for one story, in STAR order. Every line comes from the story bank / profile.
StarOutline.title: StarOutline

message.description: Human sentence for the hero / menu bar.
message.title: Message

SuggestedPreferences.description: Job-search preferences suggested from the resume; the app pre-fills, the user saves.

years_experience.description: From the profile, else estimated from work history.
years_experience.title: Years Experience

SuggestedPreferences.title: SuggestedPreferences

ThankYouDraft.description: Never sent by the engine. It may later become an outreach draft.
ThankYouDraft.title: ThankYouDraft

UpdateContactPayload.description: Only the keys present are applied; null clears an optional field.
UpdateContactPayload.title: UpdateContactPayload

notes.description: Free-form user notes; null or empty clears them.
notes.title: Notes

status.description: 'shortlisted' starts a scout; 'dismissed' never suggests it again.

watch.description: Also add the company to the job watchlist.
watch.title: Watch

UpdateVoiceProfilePayload.description: Only the keys present are applied; null resets that field to its default.
UpdateVoiceProfilePayload.title: UpdateVoiceProfilePayload

jobs.description: Jobs (skipped or rejected) whose description asks for it.
jobs.title: Jobs

UpskillHints.description:
Skills that keep appearing in jobs you were skipped for or rejected from but are not in your
profile. Advisory: learn them if they fit your direction; never claim a skill you don't have.

min_jobs.description: A skill must appear in at least this many jobs to be listed.
min_jobs.title: Min Jobs

UpskillHints.title: UpskillHints

VariantPerformance.description: Per resume variant, same measures as the dashboard's "By resume variant" card.
VariantPerformance.title: VariantPerformance

VoiceProfile.description:
The user's writing voice for generated text (cover letters, outreach, long form answers).
``ack.result`` for ``get_voice_profile`` / ``update_voice_profile``; stored in ``meta``.

sign_off.description: Closing line before the name, without the trailing comma.
sign_off.title: Sign Off

max_words.description: Upper bound for a cover letter or email body.
max_words.title: Max Words

avoid_phrases.description: Phrases the user never wants in their text (flagged, not rewritten).
avoid_phrases.title: Avoid Phrases

writing_sample.description: A short sample of the user's own writing: style only, never a source of facts.
writing_sample.title: Writing Sample

VoiceProfile.title: VoiceProfile
